Job Title: Automation Tester
 Location : India(Remote)
 Experience : 5+yrs
 Responsibilities:

• Develop and implement automated test scripts for web and mobile applications.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and deliver high-quality testing solutions.

• Design, execute, and maintain automated test scenarios to ensure software quality.

• Identify, report, and track software defects to resolution.

• Perform regression testing to validate software releases.

• Participate in test planning, estimation, and strategy discussions.

• Collaborate with developers to integrate automated tests into the continuous integration (CI) pipeline.

• Stay updated on industry best practices, tools, and technologies related to test automation.

 Requirements:

• Proven experience as an Automation Tester or similar role.

• Strong coding skills, preferably in languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.

• Selenium with Python ,worked on libraries like Pytest, PAF.

• Solid understanding of testing methodologies, SDLC, and STLC.

• Familiarity with API testing and tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured).

• Proficient in version control systems (e.g., Git).

• Knowledge of CI/CD processes and tools.

• ISTQB or other relevant certifications are a plus.
